create_time.Description: The time at which the Secret was created.

deletion_policy.Description:
The deletion policy for the secret version. Setting 'ABANDON' allows the resource
to be abandoned rather than deleted. Setting 'DISABLE' allows the resource to be
disabled rather than deleted. Default is 'DELETE'. Possible values are:
  * DELETE
  * DISABLE
  * ABANDON

destroy_time.Description: The time at which the Secret was destroyed. Only present if state is DESTROYED.

enabled.Description: The current state of the SecretVersion.

is_secret_data_base64.Description: If set to 'true', the secret data is expected to be base64-encoded string and would be sent as is.

name.Description:
The resource name of the SecretVersion. Format:
'projects/{{project}}/secrets/{{secret_id}}/versions/{{version}}'

secret_data.Description: The secret data. Must be no larger than 64KiB.
